subject: PAR rejected for Myinfo Business app with authentication_context_type
description: Partner reuses their Corppass Login PAR code for a Myinfo Business app and gets invalid_request.
resolution: `authentication_context_type` and `authentication_context_message` apply only to Corppass Login apps. If provided for a Myinfo Business application the request is rejected. Partner removed the parameters for the Myinfo Business client.

subject: authentication_context_type value rejected
description: Partner sends `authentication_context_type=APP_LOGIN` and receives invalid_request.
resolution: The value must be one of the types allow-listed for the client ID. Partner requested the right context type to be configured for their digital service.

subject: invalid_dpop_proof on PAR endpoint
description: Partner's PAR call returns 401 invalid_dpop_proof. Their server clock is 4 minutes behind.
resolution: DPoP proofs are rejected if expired or with invalid claims. The skewed `iat` made the proof look stale. Partner enabled NTP sync and generates a fresh proof per request.

subject: invalid_request — JWKS endpoint unreachable
description: Every PAR request fails with invalid_request, though parameters look correct.
resolution: One listed cause is that Corppass cannot reach the client's JWKS endpoint. Partner's JWKS was on an internal-only host. Moved it to a publicly accessible URL.

subject: invalid_client after rotating keys
description: Partner rotated keys in production; token requests now fail with invalid_client.
resolution: The client's JWKS did not yet contain the new signing key when they began signing with it. Advised to publish new keys first, wait for caches to refresh, then switch signing, and remove old keys later.

subject: Outage after Corppass certificate rotation
description: Partner's backend suddenly cannot connect to Corppass endpoints with TLS handshake errors.
resolution: Partner pinned the Corppass TLS leaf certificate. Corppass rotates certificates periodically without notice. Advised removing the pin and trusting AWS root CAs.

subject: Request for Corppass IP addresses to whitelist
description: Partner's network team wants a fixed list of Corppass IPs for outbound firewall rules.
resolution: Corppass runs on AWS CloudFront with a dynamic IP pool, so whitelisting by IP is not advised. Recommended domain-based whitelisting.

subject: invalid_request due to TLS cipher suite
description: A legacy Java 8 backend gets invalid_request from PAR although parameters are valid.
resolution: The TLS cipher suite used was not compliant with FAPI 2.0 security requirements. Partner upgraded the JVM and restricted to compliant ciphers.

subject: Callback URL mismatch between staging and production
description: Login works in staging but fails in production with invalid_request.
resolution: The production digital service did not have the production callback URL registered. `redirect_uri` must match a registered Callback URL exactly, including https. Configure in both environments.

subject: Cannot log in to CDP
description: Developer receives an access error when logging in to the Corppass Developer Portal.
resolution: User must log in as a Business User and be authorised for the CDP digital service by their entity's Corppass Admin. Admin assigned the access.

subject: Logged in to CDP but no digital services listed
description: Developer can log in to CDP but sees no digital services.
resolution: They were in the Production environment while the service was created in Staging, and also lacked the role to view services. Switched environment and admin assigned roles.

subject: Difference between CDP and Agency Admin portal
description: Agency asks whether to configure their digital service in CDP or the Corppass Agency Admin portal.
resolution: Explained the split using the FAQ 'How is CDP different from Corppass AA Portal?'. Technical configuration (JWKS, callback URLs) is in CDP.

subject: Userinfo returns invalid_token
description: Partner calls userinfo with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and receives invalid_token.
resolution: Access tokens are DPoP-bound. Partner must send `Authorization: DPoP <token>` plus a DPoP proof including the `ath` (access token hash) claim.

subject: Entity financials missing for newly incorporated company
description: Partner expects `financials` for a company incorporated two months ago and gets no data.
resolution: Newly incorporated entities may not yet have records at the source. Partner should handle empty/unavailable data and allow manual input.

subject: Migrating Myinfo Business v2 with Person v3 flow
description: Partner on Myinfo Business v2 also retrieves applicant data via Person v3 and asks how to migrate.
resolution: Followed the 'Myinfo Business (v1/v2) Person v3 flows' guide: create a new Myinfo (v5) app first, then apply the step-by-step flow changes and migration checklist.

subject: Data minimisation feedback on scope request
description: Partner's request for shareholders, appointments and financials scopes was sent back for revision.
resolution: Myinfo Business key principles require requesting only the data needed for the stated purpose. Partner narrowed the scopes and justified each.

subject: Nonce mismatch in ID token
description: Partner's ID token validation fails on nonce in a multi-tab scenario.
resolution: Nonce and state must be unique per authorisation session and stored per session. The second tab overwrote the stored nonce. Partner keyed session storage by state.

subject: User has no access to digital service
description: Business users are redirected back with access_denied.
resolution: The user's entity admin had not assigned the digital service to the user in Corppass. Advised partner to show guidance to contact their Corppass Admin.

subject: Where to get the user's roles for my service
description: Partner needs the user's role/authorisation for their digital service.
resolution: Request the `authinfo` scope; authorisation details are returned as `auth_info`. Third-party authorisation appears in `tp_auth_info`.

subject: Token endpoint returning 503 temporarily_unavailable
description: Partner sees a spike of 503 temporarily_unavailable on token calls for 10 minutes.
resolution: Matches a short maintenance/high-load window. Advised exponential backoff retry and checking the status channel. No partner-side change.

subject: JWKS configuration for multiple digital services
description: Agency with 3 digital services asks whether they can share one JWKS.
resolution: Pointed to 'JWKS Configurations' in the onboarding notes; each digital service registers its JWKS endpoint, keys must have unique kids.
